subject: Post-demo recap: monthly token cadence & procurement thresholds
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@acmeretail.com>, Sam Cohen <sam.cohen@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Sep 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + a couple clarifying asks (token cadence & PO threshold)

Hi Elaine / Sam —

Great to meet you both on the demo earlier. Quick recap of what we captured and two small asks so we can put a tight pilot SOW together:

What we heard (high level)
- Peak flows: product search + conversational assistance during daytime hours (US PT peak).
- Estimated call pattern: ~20k sessions/day, median prompt+response length roughly 600 tokens.
- Target integration: realtime chat + batch rerank job (nightly).

Preliminary numbers we ran on our side
- Estimated steady-state token burn: ~12–18M tokens / month (with peak days up to ~24M).
- Suggested commercial band for the pilot: $20k–$60k / month (this maps to ~10–40M tokens depending on model choice and quantization).
- For partner planning: baseline target unit economics you mentioned were in the ~$1,000–$1,400 per 1M tokens range — confirmed?

Two clarifying asks so SOW + billing ladder are accurate
1) Procurement threshold: does Acme require a PO for monthly invoices above a fixed monthly amount (example: PO required for any invoice > $50k) or only for multi-month/annual commitments? If you can confirm the dollar threshold and whether Finance needs an approved PO before the first invoice, that will determine whether we route pilot through monthly invoices or an initial PO.
2) Goal unit price: you mentioned a target $/1M token — please confirm the single target number we should aim for in commercial proposals (we can model a small pilot discount if you commit to a follow-on reserved band).

Next steps I propose
- If you confirm procurement threshold + target $/1M, I’ll produce a one-page pilot commercial ladder and a short SOW draft for legal + procurement.
- I’ll attach the usage worksheet we used so you can sanity-check the token math.

Attachments: usage-estimates.xlsx (token model), Acme_Pilot_SOW_v0.2.docx (draft skeleton)

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 20m call with Finance if that helps.

Best,
Priyom

Subject: Re: Quick recap + a couple clarifying asks (token cadence & PO threshold)

Thanks Priyom — great session. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement threshold
- Our finance policy: a PO is required for any single-month invoice that exceeds $40,000. For pilots under that amount we can do monthly invoices via our procurement card or AP team.
- For multi-month/annual contracts we will always issue a PO and start the formal legal review, but pilot projects under $40k/month are typically OK with standard T&Cs.

2) Target unit price
- For the initial pilot we are aiming for ~$1,200 / 1M tokens (we can flex between $1,100–$1,300 depending on latency and model choice).

3) Band confirmation
- Given our expected usage pattern, realistic pilot burn is 12–20M tokens/month. So your $20k–$60k band seems in the right shape; practically speaking, we’d plan for a 60-day pilot at the lower end (~$20k–$30k/month) and re-evaluate mid-pilot.

4) Timing and next steps
- Can you get a short SOW + the simplest billing ladder (monthly invoice examples at $20k/$30k/$45k) by EOD tomorrow? Procurement wants the PO threshold clarified on the SOW appendix so they know when to route to purchasing.

Regards,
Elaine
Director, Product Integrations | Acme Retail
elaine@acmeretail.com
